key_claims: Al-Qa'ida uses fraudulently acquired Saudi passports to document operatives and facilitate international travel.
Some Saudi passports are stolen, and others are issued to terrorists under false pretenses.
Forgers fraudulently issue or alter passports to create false identities and impersonate other citizens.
Thousands of Saudi passports were lost or stolen in recent years.
Saudi blank passports are especially problematic because they lack the document control number used to track them before issuance.
In late 2001 Saudi Arabia began moving to new-style passports that are harder to fraudulently issue or alter.
